name: SRM Contractors Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2008, SRM Contractors Ltd 
is engaged in construction of roads including bridges, tunnel works, and slope stabilisation works[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
The company specializes in infrastructure development in challenging terrains like Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Arunachal Pradesh, Gujarat, and Odisha. It focuses on EPC and HAM contracts, with expertise in road & bridge construction, tunnel construction, slope stabilization, and civil projects such as government housing, flood control, drainage, and irrigation.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 68.8% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.5%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 47.2 days to 70.3 days
